candidate.answerReason: The odd powers are \(-1\) and the even powers are \(1\). The \(2006\) terms form \(1003\) cancelling pairs.

methods.label: Pair consecutive terms
methods.explanation:
An odd power of \(-1\) is \(-1\), and an even power is \(1\). Pair each odd-indexed term with the following even-indexed term. Every pair sums to
\[
(-1)+1=0.
\]
Because \(2006=2\cdot1003\), all the terms fit into \(1003\) such pairs with none left over. The sum is \(\boxed{0}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
